== Summary ==
Only surviving copy (thumbnail, 50×38). Decipher's caption: "Chris Swearingen, Decipher field op and '97 Star Trek CCG World Finalist, updates the Star Trek CCG World Finals monster board with Game 2 results." Photo: Decipher. See [[DecipherCon 1999]] and [[DecipherCon 1999 photographs]].
